title: Answer Animation for the Learning Path
changes: Selecting an answer now feels more responsive: a quick press effect on tap, a satisfying pop when you're right, and a gentle shake when you're not.
The answer reveal on recall cards now fades and slides in smoothly instead of snapping into place.
Covers every core learning-path answer type: meaning, listening, reading, kanji, sentence, kana, and self-graded recall (Again/Hard/Good/Easy).
All animation respects your device's reduced-motion setting — nothing new to turn off, it's automatic.
CSS-only change: no new screens, no changes to scoring or session flow.
